TIFF codec — references/image/src/codecs/tiff.rs (849) + tiff@0.11.2 Classic TIFF (II/MM, 42). Strips + tiles, chunky + planar, compressions None/LZW/Deflate/PackBits, predictors, photometrics incl. YCbCr/CMYK/palette. JPEG-in-TIFF and BigTIFF return Unsupported.
